card.name: Small words in Canadian and Japanese history
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, a, the) in historical timelines, mostly Canadian history and also Meiji-era Japan. They come just before a country, institution, or event name.

modes.label: Canadian history timelines
modes.description: Words like in, a, the right before a place, state or institution in a list of dated events about Canada.
modes.example: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia and Canada are united<< in>> a federal state, the Dominion of Canada

modes.label: Japanese history
modes.description: A word or space just before a date or war name in Japan's 19th-century history.
modes.example: Yokohama: a port near Edo, opened to foreigners in<< >>1859.
